The pirates' rum-room, with barrels and jugs
The pirates' kitchen, with pots and pans

An old sailor tied up with ropes and chains
A pirate hiding from the sharks in the bay

The Doctor showed him the key to go free
The Doctor told him that Ben Ali was gone
The Doctor laughed like a friend, not a pirate

He was clever at sailing a ship in all weathers
He could talk to the fishes of the sea

To show the boy that he was not really listening

A black beard and a little gold ring in one ear

Gray hair and a ship tattooed on his hand

questions.q: The shell-fish call the porpoises "The Ocean Gossips." What is a gossip?
choices: Someone who swims faster than everyone else
Someone who keeps secrets and never tells them
Someone who sings loudly to the other fishes
Someone who hears and passes on lots of news
questions.evidence: We hear all the salt-water news

questions.q: What happened after the Doctor told the boy what the porpoises said?
choices: The boy went up on deck to look for his uncle
The eagles flew off in every direction to search
The pushmi-pullyu gave the boy a ride
The Doctor followed the porpoises toward Brazil
questions.evidence: the pushmi-pullyu took the little boy on his back
